description: Get Google search volume, difficulty, intent, CPC and 12-month history for specific keywords in one country. Missing values are unknown, not zero. Changes nothing and uses no credits; each store has a daily limit.

language.description: Language code, e.g. "en". Defaults to the store’s language.

location.description: Target country, e.g. "United States". Ask the merchant which countries they sell to if unknown.

store.description: The connected store to use. Omit when only one is connected.

name: get_keyword_metrics
title: Get keyword metrics
